title: Development Task Card
description: A per-function hand-off card derived from the built-in COSMIC chain: one task row per upstream data movement, CFP preserved and converted to hours, plus acceptance points. Anchor fields (index/funcId/reqNo/reqTitle/l1Name) are copied from the upstream artifacts.

index.description: 1-based position of this function in the upstream plan functions array; copied from the upstream artifact

funcId.description: Function id copied from the upstream artifact

reqNo.description: Requirement number copied from the upstream artifact

reqTitle.description: Requirement title copied from the upstream artifact

l1Name.description: Level-1 module name copied from the upstream artifact

l2Name.description: Level-2 module name copied from the upstream artifact when it declares one

l3Name.description: Level-3 module name copied from the upstream artifact when it declares one

summary.description: What this card asks the developer to build: a self-contained summary distilled from the upstream funcDesc and process list (>= 40 chars, no placeholders)

tasks.description: One row per upstream tech data movement, in upstream order — the unit of work the developer picks up

seq.description: 1-based task number, continuous across the whole card

process.description: Owning functional process name, same as the upstream tech process

dataGroup.description: Data group the movement operates on, same as the upstream sub-process

movementType.description: COSMIC data movement type: E=Entry, X=eXit, R=Read, W=Write — same as the upstream sub-process

description.description: What moves, distilled from the upstream movement description (>= 8 chars)

cfp.description: COSMIC size of this movement, copied from the upstream sub-process

acceptance.description: Concrete acceptance points a reviewer can verify, derived from the upstream business rules and process behavior

point.description: One verifiable statement of an observable result
